weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE is exact-field only — cannot tally status suffixes
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE bag ':on' returns 0 even when many name:on rows exist. Agents expecting suffix/role counts must GREP ':on' then LINES. The form name invites 'count lines matching' but means 'count exact field equality'.

weaknesses.title: SETMATCH replaces first exact match only — duplicates residual
weaknesses.detail: Two beta:on fields → SETMATCH beta:on→beta:off leaves one beta:on. No SETMATCHALL. Flag boards with accidental dupes stay inconsistent after toggle.

weaknesses.title: SYS RENAME (file) vs SYS MOVELINE (bag) name collision
weaknesses.detail: Agents say 'rename flag' or 'move flag to front' and may call RENAME (filesystem) instead of MOVELINE/SETMATCH. Catalog planes differ (host file vs bag) but both are SYS *MOVE* family in mental model.
weaknesses.repro: forms: RENAME path; MOVELINE bag from to

weaknesses.title: No string concat — flag tokens via REPLACEALL template
weaknesses.detail: name:on built as REPLACEALL on NAME:VAL placeholders. Names equal to VAL/NAME tokens can corrupt. Same class as roster board.
weaknesses.repro: template NAME:VAL with NAME containing VAL

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line flag bags
weaknesses.detail: list dumps flags as dark_mode:onbeta:onlegacy:off — unparseable for agents.

weaknesses.title: GREP still substring-unsafe for name: prefix identity
weaknesses.detail: GREP 'beta:' matches mybeta:on. Program uses EACH+BEFORE+EQS for identity; list tallies via GREP ':on' are OK (suffix) but name filters must not use GREP name:.

workarounds: Suffix tallies: GREP ':on'|':off' then SYS LINES — not COUNTLINE
Identity: EACH LINE + BEFORE ':' + EQS name before SETMATCH/MOVELINE
Dedup flags before toggle; or loop SETMATCH until COUNTLINE old==0
PRINT_JSON only on_n/off_n scalars; keep bag on FLAGS.txt plate
Use MOVELINE for bag reorder; RENAME only for filesystem paths
language_gaps: COUNTLINE suffix / field-pattern tally (or GREP count without materialize)
Doc cross-link RENAME vs MOVELINE clearly in forms catalog
